title: Austin Startup Week — vendor ops & reimbursements journal
content:
Purpose: running a small Redwood presence at Austin Startup Week (booth + two lightning talks). This is my private ops journal — messy. Use for quick reference and to hand over to Events Ops lead (Priya) after ship.

Key dates / times (local CDT):
- Arrival: Wed 2026-03-18 morning (flight lands 9:15am AUS) — check-in to Hyatt Regency Austin by 12:00.
- Booth setup window: Wed 3/18 1:00pm–5:00pm (drive crew + AV).
- Day 1 (Thu 3/19): Booth 9:00am–6:00pm; Lightning talk #1 at 2:30pm — "Efficient inference for startups" (15m).
- Day 2 (Fri 3/20): Booth 9:00am–4:00pm; Lightning talk #2 at 11:00am — "Reducing per-token cost with smart batching" (20m).
- Tear down: Fri 3/20 4:00pm–6:00pm.

Hotel: Hyatt Regency Austin (confirmed)
- Reservation name: Redwood Inference — Evelyn Zhang
- Confirmation #: HY-554321
- Address: 208 Barton Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78704
- Front desk: +1 512-477-1234 (check-in desk ext 102)
- Notes: early check-in requested; if room not ready hold luggage at bell desk (charge waived for partners).

Travel / flight notes
- Outbound: SFO -> AUS, United UA234, dep SFO 6:00am 3/18, arr AUS 9:15am 3/18. Seat 12A (aisle). Checked bag allowed per corporate travel policy.
- Return: AUS -> SFO, United UA567, dep AUS 6:00pm 3/20, arr SFO 9:20pm 3/20.
- Expense notes: flight booked on company card; personal incidentals (snacks, Ubers not exceeding $50/day) will be claimed via expense report.

Booth / onsite vendors
- AV / staging: LoneStar Events Co.
  - Contact: Jenna Morales (operations) j.morales@lonestarevents.com, +1 512-555-8181
  - Setup lead: arrives 12:30pm Wed; will bring stand, monitor (2x 32"), small table lights, power strips. Confirm HDMI adapter needs.
- Furniture / extra tables: Central Exhibit Rentals
  - Contact: Marcus Reed, marcus@centralrentals.com, +1 512-555-2280
- Local print shop (flyers, last-minute signage): QuickPrint Austin
  - Contact: Ana, orders@quickprint.atx, +1 512-555-9022 (open 8am–6pm)
- Shipping / freight to venue: ShipAhead Logistics
  - Pickup window for crates: Tue 3/17 9am–5pm; arrival at venue Wed morning. Account billed to Redwood (acct RED-2026).

Vendor action items to confirm (prior to travel):
- [ ] Jenna to confirm HDMI + USB-C adapters included? If not, bring 2x USB-C -> HDMI dongles from office kit.
- [ ] Central Exhibit to confirm tablecloth color (Redwood burgundy) and two side skirts.
- [ ] QuickPrint to provide proof for 8.5x11 one-sheet by Wed 9am.
- [ ] ShipAhead: provide tracking and delivery ETA to exhibitor loading dock (request delivery between 8:00–10:00 Wed).

Booth staffing plan
- Thu 9–1: Evelyn (AM) + Marco (PM) — Marco to run demo flow B (batching demo).
- Fri 9–12: Priya (AM) + Evelyn (midday talk) — Evelyn to present at 11:00.
- Backup: if someone delayed, ask floats in #events-ops Slack channel: @events-oncall.

Demos & assets to bring
- Laptop: MacBook Pro (company) with 2 profiles: hosted-sandbox + dedicated-demo. Passwords in 1Password folder "Austin-2026".
- HDMI dongles: 2x USB-C->HDMI, 1x miniDP->HDMI.
- Demo kit: small GPU server (NVIDIA T4 in pelican case) — optional if shipping arrives.
- Printed one-pagers (100) + business cards (200).
- Swag: stickers (200), notebook pads (50), pens (50).

Expense / reimbursement checklist (for my claims)
- Eligible: flights, hotel nights (Thu & Fri if not extended), booth fees (prepaid by finance), ground transportation (Uber/taxi to/from airport), meals within per diem, printing for booth, local vendor charges (AV extra).
- Not eligible: alcohol over team dinner limit, personal souvenirs.
- Receipts: photograph receipts immediately and upload to Expensify under report "Austin SW 2026 - Evelyn". Code expenses with GL: MARKETING-EXH (booth), TRAVEL-FLIGHT, TRAVEL-HOTEL, TRAVEL-GROUND, PROMO-SWAG.
- Per diem reminder: $75/day domestic; team dinner cap $120/person — if dinner exceeds, mark 'business meal justification' in expense notes.

Open questions / risks
- Q: Do we have a second hotspot SIM? Hotel Wi-Fi seems flaky for streaming; Marco volunteered his MiFi but shipping extra SIM (AT&T) to hotel front desk for pickup is fallback.
- Q: AV mic — are we supplying lapel mic for lightning talk? Jenna said "lapel not included" — need to request one or bring shotgun mic.
- Risk: flight delay for Marco (connecting flight) — plan: Marco to pick up later shift; if both delayed, use community booth help and reschedule talk (notify conference ops).

Post-event deliverables / follow-ups
- [ ] Submit expense report (Evelyn) within 7 days of return. Attach all receipts + explanations.
- [ ] Upload final attendee leads CSV to Sales Ops (label: ATX-2026-leads). Map to lead-source = "Austin Startup Week".
- [ ] Write short postmortem (1 page) with booth metrics: leads, demo conversions, swag leftover. Due Wed 3/25.
- [ ] Replace demo dongles and replenish swag kit (inventory: stickers 120 left, cards 40 left).

Quick packing checklist (travel size):
- Laptop + charger, USB-C->HDMI dongles (x2), miniDP->HDMI, spare battery pack, ethernet cable (15ft), dongle bag.
- Business cards, printed one-pager pack, swag bag.
- Shirt + blazer (speaker), extra casual for booth staff, sneakers for long days.
- Travel meds, throat lozenges, hand sanitizer, mints.

Notes to self (informal)
- Bring spare demo account API key with quota limits set — avoid using primary keys on demo machine.
- Remind finance to pre-authorize ShipAhead charges to avoid hold-ups.
- Slack: ping #events-ops 48 hours before with final roster and booth photo.

Meeting log (quick)
- 2026-02-26: call with Jenna — she confirmed monitor sizes and power strips. Asked about mic (they don’t provide).
- 2026-03-02: print proof approved by Marco.
- 2026-03-05: shipped crates via ShipAhead (tracking: SA-334455). ETA venue 3/18 8:30am.

Hand-off notes if I’m out sick
- Priya: you have full signatory for extra AV purchases up to $500. Expense must be pre-approved via Slack thread #events-ops.
- Marco: you are backup presenter for Thu talk; use slides v1.2 in drive link under "AustinSlides_v1.2".

Unresolved items (short)
- [ ] Lapel mic procurement (who buys, cost estimate).
- [ ] Confirm hotel early check-in fee waiver.
- [ ] Final headcount for swag order (need to order +50 stickers if >6 people).

If anything critical happens on travel day, call me on mobile +1 415-555-0199 (Evelyn). Otherwise, use #events-ops Slack for rapid coordination.

End of scratchpad — will tidy into a proper runbook after the trip.
